task.title: Saving radio stations automatically
task.shortdesc: The previously chosen broadcasting station will be received.

step.cmd: Press the AM or FM button repeatedly to select the band.

info.p: The previously chosen broadcasting station will be received.

step.cmd: Press and hold the AST button to automatically save receivable frequencies to Preset button.

result.p: "AST" is shown , and then stores stations in the order of their frequencies on the Preset buttons.
Up to 6 stations can be stored in each of the AMA and FMA band
